   780→    #[must_use]
   781→    pub fn start_and_stay_in(mut self, phase: Phase) -> Self {

   786→    #[must_use]
   787→    pub fn upgrade_once(mut self, post_phase: Phase, fork_epoch: Epoch) -> Self {
   788→        for (phase, field) in self.fork_epochs_mut() {
   789→            *field = match phase.cmp(&post_phase) {
   790→                Ordering::Less => GENESIS_EPOCH,
   791→                Ordering::Equal => fork_epoch,
   792→                Ordering::Greater => FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH,
   793→            };
   794→        }
   795→
   796→        self
   797→    }
